relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: SCN9A encodes for the α-subunit of the voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.7, which is strongly expressed in nociceptive neurons (7).

relationships.subject: SCN9A
relationships.evidence_quote: Presenting as congenital insensitivity to pain, three unrelated probands carried biallelic loss-of-function mutations in SCN9A.

relationships.subject: SPTLC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Pathogenic variants in SPTLC2 reduce the substrate specificity of the serine-palmitoylCoA-transferase (SPT), leading to an increased synthesis of neurotoxic1-deoxysphingolipids (1-deoxySL) (18).

key_findings: WGS of 23 Brazilian HSN families found pathogenic variants in ATL3, SPTLC2 and SCN9A in 21.7% of families
Biallelic SCN9A loss-of-function variants (including novel p.Trp702Ter and c.3319-1G>A) caused congenital insensitivity to pain
